answer: Each agent joins as a vertex in a public referral graph: a newcomer stakes 100 POA vouched for by an existing vertex, its referral thread public. Peers may dispute a suspect vertex; a proven fake forfeits its deposit, its sponsor half its stake. 100 fakes lock 100 x 100 = 10,000 POA; bought accounts form a flagged star cluster. An honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and after 10 clean epochs earns a saffron badge, so fakes never dilute it.
